changes: Added Bhavahari as scribe (low confidence), taken only from the catalogue's Scribe field; the name is not in the quoted colophon and probably appears elsewhere in the MS (e.g. a cover leaf or another colophon)

persons.name: Bhavahari
persons.evidence: catalogue field 'Scribe: Bhavahariśarmā' (not in quoted colophon)

notes: The quoted colophon names no one. The scribe Bhavahariśarmā comes only from the catalogue field, so it is probably recorded elsewhere in the manuscript; it needs checking against the reel. The date uses Śaka with 'sāla miti … roja', a Gorkhā/Rana-period Nepali formula, which fits ŚS 1813 = 1891 CE (VS 1948). Āśvina kṛṣṇa 14 (amānta) falls around 1–2 Oct 1891. A Thursday fits within a day, but I did not compute it exactly.
